meta.episodeScoreNote: Actionability and information-gain scores are research-prioritization heuristics, not market forecasts.
meta.schemaNote: Each episode identifies actor, trigger, job, artifact, surface complaint, believed cause, mechanism, workflow, actor incentives, economics, buyer, distribution, competitors, intervention, experiment, success metric, kill criterion and claims.

high-stakes-document-interpretation.title: High-stakes document interpretation
high-stakes-document-interpretation.definition: The information technically exists, but the buyer must combine multiple dense artifacts into one irreversible decision.
high-stakes-document-interpretation.diagnosticQuestion: Can a small amount of better interpretation prevent a large financial or legal mistake?

deadline-bureaucracy.title: Deadline-driven bureaucracy
deadline-bureaucracy.definition: A valuable outcome is blocked by multi-step rules, approvals or third parties while costs accumulate with time.
deadline-bureaucracy.diagnosticQuestion: Is there a detectable clock, and does every day of uncertainty have a price?

fragmented-entitlement-navigation.title: Fragmented entitlement navigation
fragmented-entitlement-navigation.definition: The user may qualify for scarce or subsidized services, but access requires coordination across separate programs and providers.
fragmented-entitlement-navigation.diagnosticQuestion: Does the customer know what they qualify for but still fail to convert eligibility into a real service?

coordination-collapse.title: Multi-party coordination collapse
coordination-collapse.definition: No single actor owns the entire outcome, so humans manually bridge handoffs, missing context and stale status.
coordination-collapse.diagnosticQuestion: How many people, systems and organizations must agree before the job is actually done?

scope-revenue-leakage.title: Scope and revenue leakage
scope-revenue-leakage.definition: Value is delivered before the organization notices the work is outside scope, underpriced or unrecoverable.
scope-revenue-leakage.diagnosticQuestion: Can we detect the commercial boundary crossing before labor is spent?

invisible-operational-leakage.title: Invisible operational leakage
invisible-operational-leakage.definition: Small losses accumulate continuously but become visible only in delayed aggregate reporting.
invisible-operational-leakage.diagnosticQuestion: What controllable loss is discovered only after the action window has closed?

ai-trust-governance-gap.title: AI trust and governance gap
ai-trust-governance-gap.definition: AI adoption grows faster than the organization's ability to verify, govern, explain and reconstruct its use.
ai-trust-governance-gap.diagnosticQuestion: Where has generation or adoption outrun verification capacity?

exception-overload.title: Exception overload
exception-overload.definition: High-value experts inspect a large mixed stream because the few items needing judgment are not separated from routine work.
exception-overload.diagnosticQuestion: What percentage of items really require the expensive person's attention?
